FAIQA KIRAN — PAKISTANI CLOTHING BRAND LOOKBOOK

Open index.html in a browser. All images are stored locally in assets/images. Custom CSS is in assets/css, JavaScript in assets/js, and the offline Bootstrap-compatible CSS/JS essentials are in assets/bootstrap.

Note: The vendor files are a lightweight offline Bootstrap-compatible subset (grid, containers, utilities and collapse helper), not the complete official Bootstrap release. Full Bootstrap files can be obtained from https://getbootstrap.com/ when internet access is available. Google Fonts are loaded online; system fonts will be used offline. Newsletter is a front-end demo and does not save addresses.
